payload.title: Domain-robust original-view coefficient learning
payload.statement: Using exactly one original 142-feature E011 vector per source well, a domain-balanced or distributionally robust training objective selected strictly inside outer-training partitions can preserve the original-only coefficient signal while improving worst spatial/typewell transfer without subgroup routing at inference.
payload.evidence_for: T027's original-only direction retains 0.0919232588 aggregate gain and has large hidden-label per-well placement headroom of 0.5264020428 RMSE.
payload.evidence_against: The frozen T028 preimplementation screen finds no nonzero common placement improving all ten domains. Global re-placement adds only 0.0006439149 RMSE, while illegal domain-specific placement adds only 0.0397890310 on spatial partitions and 0.0494021213 on typewell partitions, both below the 0.05 worth floor.
payload.next_test: Closed by D034 before implementation. Do not retune the 0.05 threshold, group definitions, placement, or objective family.
